risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
series is close to noise; fitted weights would overfit
diagnosis.narrative: The series carries a strong long-run trend. Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The spectrum is close to white noise, so most of the variation is irregular and hard to predict. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (1 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.142), which favours a robust combination.

attempts.rationale: The series shows strong trend and seasonality but unstable model ranking; a robust weighted combination using inverse error should help.
The series has unstable rankings and strong seasonality, so a robust trimmed mean should reduce influence of outlier models.
test a robust weighted scheme that downweights high-error models via softmax; this differs from inverse_error and may capture the unstable ranking.
trend is very strong but ranking unstable, a robust median might outperform trimmed mean.
Try a forward‑selection weighted combo (w4) to see if greedy selection beats trimmed mean in this unstable ranking scenario.
test a simple mean combination on the full pool to see if a non-robust baseline beats trimmed_mean, given the unstable ranking and strong seasonality.
The ranking is unstable and several groups of correlated models exist; a robust dba combination might outperform trimmed mean.
The series has unstable ranking and many correlated groups; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting may capture changing strengths across horizons.
Test a weighted softmax on a reduced robust pool to see if a more aggressive weight improves over dba; the series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality.
Testing a robust weighted combination on a smaller, correlated‑group pool (pool4) using inverse_error weights to see if reducing noise improves over dba.

decision.justification: Selected 'dba on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9023. Series context: trend strength 0.9995 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.142); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.979.
